tasks.short: Tell board attendants which tables have verified vacancies

steps.what: Attendants observe table occupancy and enter actual changes on the existing table board
outputs: Current occupancy entries with observation times

steps.what: Find the relevant table and latest occupancy entry in the existing board; configure its native table filter
outputs: Located original occupancy entry and its time

steps.what: Check the table itself for usable vacancies, current play and any temporary seat restriction
outputs: Verified available places at an identified table

steps.what: Tell the board attendant the verified table vacancies and resolve an unclear table or seat reference orally
outputs: Attendant has the current vacancy information

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} table-board view to locate a table's latest original entry. Retain the physical vacancy check and actual oral notification; {OTHER} means the casino floor and spoken communication.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager can spend time locating a table among current board entries before checking the floor.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing board may support a saved table filter without creating a new occupancy feed.
tasks.still_hard: A recorded empty seat may be unavailable, reserved or already occupied by the time the manager reaches it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager verifies the live conditions and gives the attendant an intelligible current message.

ambition.what: Make existing vacancy lookup easier without claiming more playable seats.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-1; confirm existing table-board access with its owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an existing occupancy board can sometimes be filtered by table; it cannot establish live seat availability without current observations.

assumptions: This is a representative episode with an actual attendant-maintained electronic table board. Its observation and entry work is explicitly retained in s1; the board is not an invented clean feed.

Shares are unmeasured task-work estimates, independent of the occupation time-share prior. Focal baseline is 95; retained focal work is 93.5. Gross saving is 1.5/95*100=1.5789 points; subtract 0.5 point new upkeep once.
If the native filtered view already exists, claim no new saving. If vacancy notification is wholly oral with no existing board lookup, do not invent board work to justify a tool.

This episode has an actual oral notification, with no written send, record write or formal seat-allocation commit hidden inside s4. Patron selection and an attendant's later seating actions remain their actual work.
unknowns: Whether the current board supports a table filter and whether managers already use it
research_questions: Observe vacancy notifications and distinguish actual board lookup from floor checking and oral communication.

already_counted.description: Attendants' actual occupancy observation and capture
Manager's original-entry reading, physical verification and oral notification

incremental.description: Keep the table filter aligned with actual table identifiers; no second occupancy entry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: 1.5789 gross minus 0.5 upkeep = 1.0789, rounded down. Low: table identifiers do not map to the native view, so all 15 lookup points remain; retain the existing manual process and incur no new helper upkeep. Floor verification and notification remain fully retained in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor recorded player credit against existing authorised limits

steps.what: Credit staff record actual advances, repayments and outstanding markers in the existing credit ledger
inputs: Actual credit transactions and player account identifiers
outputs: Recorded advances, repayments and outstanding markers

steps.what: Read the original ledger and authorised limit records, verify account mapping and identify missing or late transactions
inputs: Existing authorised player limits and their effective times
outputs: Checked source records and explicit account/limit mapping; unresolved items marked

steps.what: Sum outstanding amounts for the mapped accounts and compare them with the effective existing limits, listing unmatched records separately
inputs: Checked records and explicit mapping from s2
outputs: Draft balance/limit comparison with source references and unmatched items

steps.what: Check the comparison against source records and assess the meaning of exposure, unusual transactions and unresolved account histories
inputs: Original records and actual operating context
outputs: Manager's assessed credit-monitoring findings and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check the actual monitoring case entry, distinguishing verified facts, the manager's assessment and items awaiting clarification
Save the checked monitoring entry in the same credit system

tasks.design: Use a fixed {OPS_SYSTEM}/{SPREADSHEET} comparison for actual outstanding credit and existing authorised limits. The manager verifies source mapping, assesses exposure and writes the actual case entry; no model grants credit or changes a limit.
tasks.previous_blocker: A manual comparison can require repeatedly adding recorded markers and locating the effective limit for the same account.
tasks.enabler_now: An available ledger export and explicit account/limit mapping permit reproducible arithmetic with unmatched records left visible.
tasks.still_hard: Late transactions, ambiguous identities and the significance of a player's exposure require original-record checks and human judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The manager separates arithmetic discrepancies from a meaningful credit concern.

ambition.what: Review verified exposure more promptly if actual ledger updates support it.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; agree permitted ledger and limit access with the credit-system owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed account mappings, sums and effective-limit comparisons can be implemented deterministically; this is not evidence of measured casino savings.

assumptions: This represents a real monitoring review that currently produces a case entry, not an invented written report after every glance at a balance. Credit staff's actual transaction capture is counted in s1, and the manager's mapping and completeness checks in s2.

Shares are unmeasured estimates of this work, not the occupation time-share prior. Focal baseline is 90; retained focal work is 70. Gross saving is 20/90*100=22.2222 points, less 3 points new upkeep once.
Use the native credit-system balance/limit report first. Already automatic arithmetic earns no new saving; machine work applies only to observed repeated manual comparison.
The ordinary same-system save has minimum integer share 1 to represent negligible effort, retained in full, with no approval stage or claimed saving.

This task monitors existing credit. A change to a limit, extension of credit, account restriction or formal notice is a separate actual decision and action with the existing authority reviewing its final version; none is hidden in s5 or s6.
unknowns: Whether account identifiers and effective limits are exportable
How much comparison the native credit system already performs
research_questions: Trace actual marker entry, repayments and limit changes through one monitoring review; measure repeated manual arithmetic only.

already_counted.description: Credit staff's actual source transaction entry
Manager's source validation, exposure judgment, actual case writing and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain effective-limit mapping and verify comparison results after ledger format changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: 22.2222 gross minus 3 upkeep = 19.2222, rounded down. Low: legacy account aliases require 14 of the 20 comparison points to remain manual; only 6/90*100=6.6667 points are saved, less 3 upkeep = 3.6667, rounded down. Source verification, exposure judgment, case writing and same-system save remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Board attendants continue to observe and record actual occupancy
Credit staff continue to capture actual transactions
skills_to_grow: Verify current table information against floor conditions
Distinguish ledger arithmetic from credit judgment
Maintain explicit source and account mappings
role.ambitious_version: A manager who finds current operating information more readily while retaining live floor checks and responsibility for assessed credit exposure.
